## Checks

- [ ] `just check` is green
- [ ] Commit messages are Conventional Commits, and the type is the one I meant
      (`feat`/`fix`/`perf`/`refactor` cut a release; `docs`/`test`/`ci`/`chore`
      do not)
- [ ] If `tests/golden/rows.expected` changed, I have explained why the new
      layout is correct. It is the layout specification and cannot be
      regenerated.
- [ ] If an AI helped, the commit carries `Assisted-by:` and I have read and
      understood the change myself. See
      [AI_POLICY.md](.github/AI_POLICY.md).
